name: C++ 1 — Practice Lab (C++ Basics)
description: Guided learner workspace for the first lab of a beginner C++ course (4×45 min); all code is provided. Core exercises: observing the first program (L01), variables, assignment and division (L01b), and input, string handling and conversion with input validation (L04). Supplementary exercises: preprocessing and macros (#include, #define, -E, constexpr) and conditional compilation (#ifdef, -D, parameterized macros, assert). Compiled with g++ -std=c++20 in the workspace terminal, prediction-first.
